subject: Medalia Therapeutics — request for extended debug-trace retention and SIG/CAIQ evidence
messages:
From: Anya Kovalenko <anya.k@medalia.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extended retention for debug traces + evidence ask

Hi Olga,

Quick context: Medalia needs to keep a subset of application debug traces for a small set of tenants for 180 days (our baseline is 30 days) to support ongoing clinical reconciliation and regulatory audit requests. This is a customer-specific retention variance request tied to our SOC2 readiness window.

Can Redwood confirm what artefacts you can provide so our auditors accept a 180-day carveout? Specifically we need:
- A formal exception amendment (DocuSign or similar)
- Description of deletion workflows + proof of delete for prior samples
- SIG/CAIQ mapping that highlights log retention & deletion controls
- Sample redacted logs showing how PII is removed

I attached a short MOP that our security team drafted for what they expect (medalia_proposed-exception-mop.pdf). Happy to hop on a 30-min call next week if helpful — can loop in Derrick (legal).

Thanks,
Anya
Anya Kovalenko
Head of Security Operations, Medalia Therapeutics
anya.k@medalia.com
+1 415-555-0189

Attachments: medalia_proposed-exception-mop.pdf
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Anya Kovalenko <anya.k@medalia.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extended retention for debug traces + evidence ask

Hi Anya — thanks for the clear note and the MOP. We can support customer-specific retention carveouts in Dedicated and Private modes; for hosted tenants we typically require a formal exception approval with compensating controls.

To accelerate the auditor review, Redwood can provide the following deliverables:
- A one-page exception amendment template (DocuSign-ready) that describes scope, TTL, and custodians
- RedTeam-reviewed deletion runbook (steps, triggers, and verification logs)
- Sample deletion audit entries for previously deleted tenant traces (redacted)
- A SIG appendix that maps Redwood controls to CAIQ/SIG questions for retention/deletion
- A redacted sample of debug traces (we can produce CSV snippets with tokens/PII redacted)

Please confirm the exact tenant IDs (or subset) you want covered and whether the environment is hosted/dedicated. Also confirm the acceptance criteria your auditors need (e.g., proof-of-delete hashes, time-based snapshots). Once you confirm we'll produce the sample artifacts and propose a DocuSign amendment.

If it helps, I can propose a short intake checklist and timeline:
- By Tue (10/6): we produce SIG appendix + redacted sample
- By Fri (10/9): deletion runbook + proof-of-delete samples
- Week of 10/12: finalize amendment and routing for signatures

Would you like me to include Vivek (ops/product) and Neha (sec/compliance) on the intake call?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Trust & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

From: Anya Kovalenko <anya.k@medalia.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Derrick Lowe <d.lowe@medalia.com>, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extended retention for debug traces + evidence ask

Hi Olga — thanks, that timeline looks good. Confirming details:
- Tenants: medalia-prod-01 and medalia-prod-03 (redwood tenant IDs will be provided in a follow-up email by our SRE)
- Environment: hosted (we're asking for a customer-scoped exception in hosted)
- Audit acceptance: our auditor requires redacted samples + proof-of-delete hashes and a mapping to CAIQ/SIG controls for data deletion and access logging

I've attached:
1) medalia_debug_samples_redacted.csv — a masked export of two debug sessions for patterns only (no PHI)
2) medalia_soc2_scoping_requirements.docx — our auditor's scoping checklist

Derrick from Legal is on copy for DocuSign phrasing. We're flexible on the exact amendment wording but the amendment must state the TTL, tenant IDs, custodians, and an expiry review date (180-day carveout that auto-reviews at 12 months).

Thanks — Anya

Attachments: medalia_debug_samples_redacted.csv, medalia_soc2_scoping_requirements.docx
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Anya Kovalenko <anya.k@medalia.com>, d.lowe@medalia.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extended retention for debug traces + evidence ask

Thanks for the artifacts, Anya — I reviewed the samples and the scoping doc. Next steps from Redwood Sec/Compliance: 

1) Evidence we will produce (deliverable list):
   - redwood_sig-appendix-availability.xlsx (controls mapping to SIG/CAIQ)
   - redacted deletion audit entries (proof-of-delete with HMAC timestamps)
   - deletion runbook + verification checklist (PDF)
   - one-page amendment document for legal / DocuSign

2) Requirements we need from Medalia before we produce final evidence:
   - final confirmation of tenant IDs (please send the exact tenant GUIDs)
   - acceptance criteria for proof-of-delete (hash algorithm; we recommend SHA256 + HMAC with timestamp)
   - point of contact for delivery of the final artefacts (secure Drive or SFTP)

3) Timeline (tentative):
   - SIG appendix + redacted samples: deliver by Thu 10/8 end of day
   - deletion runbook + proof-of-delete samples: deliver by Mon 10/12
   - amendment draft for legal review: Tue 10/13

I've uploaded a secure folder for Medalia to deposit tenant GUIDs and any additional scoping notes: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_medalia_evidence (shared link). We'll prepare the DocuSign amendment and send a draft link: https://app.docusign.com/exception-amend/MDL-4789 once legal confirms phrasing.

Olga — please loop Vivek on any product constraints for hosted environments (routing, TTL enforcement) before we commit timelines.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
